name: Volunteers for Wildlife / Wildlife Center of Long Island
neighborhoods: Long Island (Nassau & western Suffolk); at Bailey Arboretum, Locust Valley
region_note: WILDLIFE (rehabilitation, NOT adoption - only NYS-licensed rehabbers may handle wild animals)
notes: 501(c)(3) wildlife hospital & education center founded 1982; ~2,000+ animals/yr and 10,000+ emergency calls a year. The primary injured/orphaned-wildlife resource for Long Island (Nassau & western Suffolk). Federally licensed, so can take most species. Doesn't do pickups except very locally - call first. Regional (Long Island) - flagged as NYC-adjacent, not NYC-local; useful for eastern-Queens/LI-border situations. Intake: Call in advance 516-674-0982 (8am-4pm Mon-Fri; email checked after hours). 194 Bayville Rd, Locust Valley. Also Other channel: IG/FB Volunteers for Wildlife / Wildlife Center of Long Island
section: WILDLIFE (rehabilitation, NOT adoption - only NYS-licensed rehabbers may handle wild animals)
